_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json. Primary part 441200MC01 confirmed via US retailer SKU (littlebe.com). Bugaboo's own Fox/Lynx/Buffalo Maxi-Cosi adapter; Clek's official list also cites it for the Kangaroo.
name: Bugaboo Fox/Lynx/Buffalo Adapter for Maxi-Cosi
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi footprint — confirm Clek Liing fits. Bugaboo's official adapter page lists it as the Fox/Lynx/Buffalo adapter for 'Maxi-Cosi' car seats (Maxi-Cosi Pebble / Pebble Plus etc.) and the same footprint used by Nuna/Cybex/BeSafe infant seats; Bugaboo's own page does NOT explicitly name Clek. Strolleria's US listing for this same Fox/Lynx adapter DOES explicitly advertise 'Clek / Cybex / Maxi-Cosi / Nuna' compatibility, and Clek's official compatibility list files the Bugaboo Fox/Fox2/Fox3/Fox5, Lynx, and Kangaroo under this part for mounting the Clek Liing/Liingo. Retailer + Clek corroboration indicate the Liing rides on this Maxi-Cosi-footprint bracket, but this is retailer/Clek-stated rather than printed on Bugaboo's own adapter page — verify at purchase. Adapter-mounted seats limited to 28.7 lb (13 kg) child weight.

status.clekNote: On Clek's official list for Fox/Fox2/Fox3/Fox5 and Lynx (as '441200MC01 or 231100MC02') and for the Kangaroo (as '441200MC01'). 441200MC01 captured here as the primary part; 231100MC02 is the Clek-listed alternate for Fox/Lynx.

install.notes: Sold as a pair (left/right). Bugaboo 'click-and-go' mount: adapters click onto the stroller frame, the Maxi-Cosi-footprint infant seat then clicks into the adapters. No tools. Adapter-mounted car seat weight limit 28.7 lb (13 kg) child.

notes: Serves Fox/Fox2/Fox3/Fox5, Lynx, Buffalo, and Kangaroo. Alternate part 231100MC02 also listed by Clek for Fox/Lynx. Primary part number 441200MC01 confirmed via US retailer SKU (littlebe.com lists sku 441200MC01). Not discontinued; in stock at US retailers (Little Be $54.95, Pacifier Kids $59.95); currently out of stock on Bugaboo DTC (MSRP $69.95). Bugaboo's official adapter page lists compatible strollers Buffalo/Fox/Fox 2/Fox 3/Fox 5/Fox 5 Renew/Fox Cub/Lynx/Turtle Air by Nuna/Otter by Nuna. Clek Liing fit is corroborated by Strolleria's US listing (explicitly 'Clek') and by Clek's own compatibility list, though Bugaboo's page itself does not print 'Clek' — reconfirm the Liing bracket at purchase.
